sources.revision: Library version 12; CMMS Propuesta de Solución, 30 October 2026, pages 3, 6 and 7

baseline_review.evidence_ref: Independent requirement inventory drafted from SRC_CMMS_PROPOSAL_2026_10_30; functional analyst review of this inventory has not yet been recorded.

views.breadcrumb: CMMS Lab / Work Queue / Annual Work Order

steps.action: Search, filter, sort or page the synthetic read-only work queue; select an annual preventive order.
Inspect approved-plan provenance, cycle context, planned preventive actions and linked execution records.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; Hernando and Eduardo are named stakeholders, but no business role or authorization is inferred.
requirements.goal: Find the preventive work represented by an annual order.
requirements.information: Order identity, asset, approved plan/activity provenance, available cycle label and summary of its periodic planned actions.
requirements.decision: Understand which planned preventive actions belong to the selected order.
requirements.action: Open an annual preventive order from the read-only queue.
requirements.validation: The order and its actions are linked to the selected synthetic asset and plan activity; unrelated activities are not combined in the demonstration.
requirements.result: The user can identify the scope of the selected annual order.
requirements.feedback: The selected order, asset, activity and action counts are visible.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; no execution or approval authority is inferred.
requirements.goal: Distinguish work planned for the cycle from work actually performed.
requirements.information: Each actuación preventiva programada, its planned date/state, and a separate linked ExecutionRecord when execution evidence exists.
requirements.decision: Determine which actions are completed and which remain planned or pending.
requirements.action: Inspect the action list and open its linked execution evidence where available.
requirements.validation: Planned dates never appear as actual dates; an action is displayed as executed only when its linked ExecutionRecord provides evidence.
requirements.result: Completed and pending actions are distinguishable without fabricating execution.
requirements.feedback: The detail shows planned state separately from actual date, result and feedback.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; no plan-approval authority is inferred.
requirements.goal: Understand the approved maintenance instruction behind the order.
requirements.information: Approved Maintenance Plan identity/version and the activity applied to the order.
requirements.decision: Recognize the plan version that the synthetic order represents.
requirements.action: Inspect the plan provenance shown in the detail.
requirements.validation: The UI shows the fixture's plan identity/version as demo data and does not imply that a new plan is approved.
requirements.result: The order can be traced to its approved-plan source in the demonstration.
requirements.feedback: Plan identity and version are visible in the order context.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; no disposition authority is inferred.
requirements.goal: Recognize completed and pending actions at the end of a cycle.
requirements.information: Counts and states for completed and pending planned preventive actions.
requirements.decision: Identify that a pending action has no execution result and has no selected disposition in this scenario.
requirements.action: Review the cycle-end summary and the pending action.
requirements.validation: The demonstration does not auto-close, carry forward or cancel the pending action and does not select a disposition.
requirements.result: The pending item remains visible as pending in the demo.
requirements.feedback: The detail explains that the scenario is synthetic and its operating disposition remains unratified.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; no technical-closure authority is inferred.
requirements.goal: Understand what was recorded after a periodic preventive execution.
requirements.information: Actual date, work performed, result and feedback available in the linked execution record.
requirements.decision: Determine what the synthetic example says was actually done.
requirements.action: Inspect the linked execution summary and available evidence.
requirements.validation: Only values present in the synthetic ExecutionRecord are shown as actuals; missing linked detail is identified as partial data.
requirements.result: The user can follow planned work to its recorded result.
requirements.feedback: The execution summary remains attached to its planned action and parent order.

requirements.actor: First walkthrough user; ownership/authorization is not inferred from the displayed state.
requirements.goal: Understand the current stage represented by an order.
requirements.trigger: Review an order in the queue or detail.
requirements.information: Synthetic order status and available preparation, scheduling or execution context.
requirements.decision: Recognize what has and has not occurred in the demonstrated process.
requirements.action: Inspect the status and linked information; no state-changing command is available.
requirements.validation: The UI does not infer preparation or scheduling completion from a planned date or parent status alone.
requirements.result: The screen presents process status without implying that the user can authorize a transition.
requirements.feedback: The status and data source are visibly labelled as demonstration where synthetic.
